name: gates-models
description: Model-tiering gates for delegation. Denies a high-fan-out Workflow script with no per-agent model: override and asks before a denylisted built-in named workflow; denies an ad-hoc Agent dispatch that omits model unless the agent type pins one in frontmatter. model-guard:ack bypasses; GATES_DISABLE turns either off. Runs a committed macOS binary with a node fallback.
